draft.title: Hypothetical Time-to-First-Token Comparison: Setup A vs. Setup B
draft.body: This post outlines a hypothetical time-to-first-token (TTFT) comparison between two setups, A and B, based on synthetic experimental input. In this hypothetical scenario, Setup A achieved a TTFT of 1.2 seconds, while Setup B recorded 2.4 seconds. Crucially, both hypothetical runs were conducted using identical prompts and hardware configurations. It is important to note that this comparison is purely theoretical and does not reflect actual measured results. No data regarding throughput, accuracy, or statistical uncertainty was provided for these hypothetical runs. The objective is to initiate a technical discussion on factors that might contribute to such a divergence in TTFT under these specific, albeit hypothetical, conditions. What architectural or configuration differences could plausibly lead to a doubling of TTFT, assuming identical hardware and prompts?
draft.plan: Present hypothetical TTFT data, state limitations clearly, and ask for technical explanations for the observed difference.
